: victory
1) salvation, deliverance

1b) salvation (spiritual in sense)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
strongs_1890.derivation: or תְּשֻׁעָה; from H7768 (שָׁוַע) in the sense of H3467 (יָשַׁע);
